final_wiki.Q-4539 GCD of 480 and 570:
GCD(480, 570) = 30

Calculation using Euclidean algorithm:
570 = 480 × 1 + 90
480 = 90 × 5 + 30
90 = 30 × 3 + 0

Therefore GCD = 30

Prime factorization verification:
480 = 2^5 × 3 × 5
570 = 2 × 3 × 5 × 19
Common factors: 2 × 3 × 5 = 30
